author: The Film Theorists
description:
Why did this Stars Wars parody NEVER see the light of day until now? Robot Chicken created a whole show for George Lucas, but Disney wasn’t having it! Find out how to watch Star Wars Detours despite Disney trying to send it off to a galaxy far, far away.
